description: Creates a chain from a template with your own values, saved as a draft that does not run yet. Then ask the user before activate_chain. The answer names the smallest plan that can activate it. Needs a key with “Read and change”.

exchange.description: Exchange ID as offered in the candle settings (get_template → parameters, setting "exchange"); default: the template’s or the app’s default.

once.description: Pause the chain after its first alert.

pair.description: Pair for the candle, for templates that read one pair.

pairs.description: Coins of a scanner template (replaces its list or top N).

items.description: Trading pair with a slash, such as BTC/USDT or ETH/EUR.

settings.description: Own values per node and setting, such as {"k1": {"value": 30}}. Node IDs, settings, ranges and options: get_template → parameters. Secret settings cannot be set.

templateId.description: Template ID from list_templates, such as "dip".

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe; applies to all candles of the chain.

name: create_chain_from_template
title: Create a chain from a template
